name: Kimi Linear 48B-A3B Instruct

benchmarks.name: MMLU-Pro (4k)
benchmarks.config: Figure figures/perf_speed.png subplot (a), red star labelled Kimi-Linear, at the 1x decoding-acceleration position. The value is also stated in the card caption in words ("On MMLU-Pro (4k context length), Kimi Linear achieves 51.0 performance"), so this row is not eye-read: figure and caption agree. 4k context; no shot count, thinking setting or harness is printed.

notes: 3:1 KDA linear-attention to MLA: only 7 of 27 layers hold a KV cache, so KV is 7.9 KiB/token (0.96 GiB at 128k, 7.5 GiB at 1M) versus ~3.7 GiB at 128k if every layer were MLA. Paper reports up to 75% KV reduction and 6x decode throughput at 1M. kv_cache_bytes_per_token derived: 7 layers x 576 (kv_lora 512 + rope 64) x 2 bytes. RELEASE DATE CORRECTED 2026-10-21: was 2026, now 2025 per the HF repo creation date (2025-10-30). The wrong year made every recency multiplier a no-op for this record. IMAGE EVALS 2026-10-23: the card publishes MMLU-Pro only as a picture. Subplot (a) of figures/perf_speed.png is a scatter of performance against decoding acceleration: Kimi-Linear sits at MMLU-Pro (4k) 51.0 and RULER (128k) 84.3. The RULER value is the row already in the record, so reading the figure independently gave 84.3 again, and 51.0 is new. Subplot (b) is TPOT vs decoding length and carries no accuracy number, so nothing was taken from it.
